content.content:
Done. Added agt delete command documentation to docs/markdown/cli-reference.md:

1. Added delete to the Table of Contents after history (line 13)
2. Added full section for agt delete (lines 327-375) with:
   - Command syntax
   - Arguments table
   - Example (leaf issue deletion)
   - Output JSON for success (single and cascade), and NOT_FOUND error
   - Notes covering: hard delete, cascade behavior, deletedIds order, blockage cleanup, mention cleanup, works on any status, requires write auth

Section follows the exact same format as update and create sections. No new error codes needed — delete reuses existing NOT_FOUND and NOT_INITIALIZED codes.

GAP FOUND: The CLI reference was updated with the delete command, but the JavaScript reference (docs/markdown/javascript-reference.md) is missing the issueDelete method documentation entirely. It needs a new section under Issues covering: tracker.issueDelete(id, params?) with usage example, parameters table, return type IssueDeleteResult showing deletedIds array, and notes about cascade behavior. Also the Exported types section at the bottom needs IssueDeleteParams and IssueDeleteResult added.
